buckets.label: Lower-division intro course
buckets.note: One of these. PH 40 (formerly FMPH 40) accepted by petition. GLBH 20 (Introduction to Global Health) is the standard choice; if GLBH 20 is used here it cannot double-count for the social science course. Catalog frames GLBH 20 as required + one from HILD 30/SOCI; department page frames intro as GLBH 20/HILD 30/PH 40.

buckets.label: Lower-division social science course
buckets.note: One of these. GLBH 20 listed as an option here per department page but typically used to satisfy the intro requirement instead. Catalog also lists HILD 30 among the second-course options.

buckets.label: Statistics course
buckets.note: One of these. Confirmed on both sources. AP Statistics score of 3+ also satisfies this requirement (by petition).

buckets.label: Upper-division Global Health core
buckets.note: All three required: GLBH 148 (Global Health and Cultural Diversity), GLBH 181 (Essentials of Global Health), MGT 173 (Project Management: Health Services). Confirmed on both sources.

buckets.label: Policy analysis course
buckets.note: One of these. USP 133 and SOCI 152 are cross-listed (same course). All codes confirmed on the catalog policy-analysis list.

buckets.label: Global Health field experience
buckets.note: Non-course requirement (confirmed): minimum 100 hours over at least 5 weeks (3 weeks if international), distributed over no more than three programs, at an approved research, service, or clinical site (domestic or abroad), completed by graduation quarter.
